steps.action: Revoke the exposed DB_PROD key immediately in the secrets manager or provider console.
steps.quote: Revoke the exposed key immediately in the secrets manager or the provider's console.

steps.action: Issue a replacement key restricted to the production database use case, preferably read-only and short-lived.
steps.quote: Issue a new key limited to the intended use, read-only if possible

steps.action: Update all services that depended on the old DB_PROD key and verify they still work.
steps.quote: Update the services that used the old key, then check that they work.

steps.action: Remove DB_PROD from .env.prod and any other repository or agent workspace files.
steps.quote: Remove the secret from every file of the repository and of the agents' workspace
